# Open Ethics Standard

> A public standard and local MCP tools for reviewing possible harmful software practices. No OES login or API key is required.

- [Agent setup guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): Install, configure, and verify the local OES MCP for your coding assistant.
- [Project and source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source code and contribution instructions.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): Canonical practice definitions.
